description: Provision a Google Cloud Iam IAMServiceAccountKey via Config Connector. Fields mirror the iam.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 IAMServiceAccountKey spec.

keyAlgorithm.description: Immutable. The algorithm used to generate the key, used only on create. KEY_ALG_RSA_2048 is the default algorithm. Valid values are: "KEY_ALG_RSA_1024", "KEY_ALG_RSA_2048".

privateKeyType.description: Immutable. The output format of the private key. TYPE_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_FILE is the default output format.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

publicKeyData.description: Immutable. A field that allows clients to upload their own public key. If set, use this public key data to create a service account key for given service account. Please note, the expected format for this field is a base64 encoded X509_PEM.

publicKeyType.description: Immutable. The output format for the public key. TYPE_NONE is the default for public key output.

serviceAccountRef.description: Immutable. The Service Account to create a key for. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

title: GCP Iam IAMServiceAccountKey
